summary: User reported that the History workspace canvas sits at the top-left after opening the Model Library and coming back. Root cause traced before any edit: the Model Library overlay stashes the workspace under a display:none div, MpiCanvas.resize() measures 0x0, and handleResize subtracts half the viewport while its oldW>0 guard then skips the matching add on restore.

Straight to doing - the diagnosis came off the screenshot geometry (a 265x417 fragment at the top-left is exactly the fitted view shifted by half the viewport) and the fix is one guard in MpiCanvas.resize().

Fixed and measured. MpiCanvas.resize() now returns early on a 0x0 container, so the Model Library overlay stashing the workspace under display:none no longer feeds handleResize a phantom resize. Browser harness on the real MpiCanvas across a display:none round trip: guard mutated out, a panned view went 137,42 -> -163,-158 (exactly -(600/2, 400/2)); guard in place it stayed 137,42. Managed views still refit a real resize. Blast radius swept - handleResize has one caller and the other three ResizeObserver consumers already reject a 0x0 read.
